prerequisites: Knowledge of Fundamentals of Mechanical Engineering and Specific Mechanical Technology

learning_outcomes.text: Will know and apply the concepts of integral industrial maintenance.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to the concept of failure and improvement tools for failure reduction.
Cause-effect Diagram - Ishikawa Diagram in maintenance.
MANAGEMENT OF PREVENTIVE AND CORRECTIVE MAINTENANCE.
Management of spare parts, consumables, and tools inventory.
Management of suppliers and external services.
Study of resource and consumption flow.
assessment_rules: To pass the course, it is necessary to obtain at least 35% of the written test grade. Otherwise, the total course grade will be the sum of the grades obtained in all evaluation criteria, up to a maximum of 4.5 points. Students with a recognized part-time study dedication may substitute non-recoverable activities with similar ones or equivalent assessment tests if the reason for non-completion is due to their part-time status.
